en.title: Find Minimum Price to Spend
en.description:
Buy all items using at most m coupons. After applying x coupons in a row to one price, the price becomes floor(price/2^x). Each coupon can be used for at most one halving of one item.

All extra constraints and the I/O format are additions by this site and do not claim to be the original platform's format.
en.input: The first line contains n m; the second line contains n positive integer prices. The source lacks constraints; added by this site: 1≤n≤100000, 0≤m≤10^9, 1≤price[i]≤10^9; the total price and the answer are output as 64-bit integers.
en.output: Output the minimum total price to buy all items after using coupons.
en.explanation: See the accompanying editorial for the algorithm, proof of correctness, and complexity.
hints: First pin down the boundaries according to the statement, then handle the validity or optimality conditions that are easiest to miss.
